column2: TWO ROWS ARE A PROPERTY OF THIS CHECKOUT, NOT OF THE TREE.
FedsInstrumentMetaTest and FedsNoteAuditionTest each fail ONE assertion
because `authored_effects/E001.feds.bin` is absent — that directory is
GITIGNORED (.gitignore:63) and this worktree holds E019's feds bank and
not E001's. A worktree that has it may score them PASS. So a diff of
those two rows after the move measures the CHECKOUT unless it is taken
on the same one. Stated rather than silently frozen.
A GREEN SUMMARY IS NOT A RUN. A coroutine error or a stale call arity
aborts a test silently, so `asserts_pass` and `script_errors` are the
evidence, not the verdict. `-` in an assert column means the test does
not count itself and `markers` is the only count it has — never zero.
THREE OF THESE TESTS NO LONGER EXIST. THE ROWS STAY, AND THAT IS THE POINT.
This file is a FROZEN MEASUREMENT of code_commit 4ed6fb5c7 — the pre-move
state extraction #2 is measured against. It cannot be re-frozen after the
move, so a row cannot be pruned when its test is later deleted: the run
still happened and `tally` still counts it. Pruning one and not the others
is what actually happened — 26d16706a removed the LateralCalib row and left
`tally FAIL 25` above a file holding 24, while 5146dcb9c and ab6368603
correctly left theirs. The row is restored; deletions are recorded HERE.

column2: A SECOND LEDGER KIND, AND THE DESTINATION IS THE POINT (ADR-0194 dec. 10).
An addon-owned test leaves tests/ for addons/<name>/tests/ and IS STILL RUN —
by tests/stranger/<addon>/run.sh, in a project that did nothing for the addon.
Recording that as `# deleted` would say the test is gone, which is false in the
half that matters, and would put two policies in one kind again. Format is
stem <TAB> destination <TAB> commit <TAB> why, and check_test_baseline.py arm 4
asserts the destination EXISTS: a move whose target is absent is a deletion.
